title: Norwegian Banana Bowl
description: A simple and delicious dessert made with Norwegian pancakes, sliced bananas, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Prepare the Norwegian pancake mix according to package instructions.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the pancake batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook the pancakes until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry, about 2 minutes.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Serve the pancakes warm in a bowl with sliced bananas and granulated sugar (if using).
Optional: Top with jazzy whipped cream and additional sliced bananas.
